import pytest
from calendar_core.slots import Event, overlaps, free_slots, parse_time, fmt_duration


def test_issue_back_to_back_exact():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    a = Event(540, 600)  # 9*60=540, 10*60=600
    b = Event(600, 660)  # 10*60=600, 11*60=660
    assert overlaps(a, b) is False  # [540,600) and [600,660) share no minute


def test_issue_back_to_back_reversed():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    a = Event(600, 660)  # 10*60=600, 11*60=660
    b = Event(540, 600)  # 9*60=540, 10*60=600
    assert overlaps(a, b) is False  # order swapped, still shares no minute


def test_issue_one_minute_shared_overlaps():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    a = Event(540, 601)  # 9*60=540, 600+1=601
    b = Event(600, 660)  # 10*60=600, 11*60=660
    assert overlaps(a, b) is True  # share exactly minute 600 -> True


def test_issue_contained_event_overlaps():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    outer = Event(540, 720)  # 9*60=540, 12*60=720
    inner = Event(600, 660)  # 10*60=600, 11*60=660
    assert overlaps(outer, inner) is True  # [600,660) inside [540,720)


def test_issue_identical_events_overlap():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    a = Event(540, 600)  # 9*60=540, 10*60=600
    b = Event(540, 600)  # 9*60=540, 10*60=600
    assert overlaps(a, b) is True  # identical intervals share 60 minutes


def test_issue_back_to_back_leaves_no_gap():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    events = [Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)]  # 9*60=540, 10*60=600, 11*60=660
    assert free_slots(events, 540, 660) == []  # 540 to 660 fully covered, no gap


def test_contract_partial_overlap_true():
    """True if the two events share at least one minute."""
    a = Event(540, 620)  # 9*60=540, 10*60+20=620
    b = Event(600, 660)  # 10*60=600, 11*60=660
    assert overlaps(a, b) is True  # share [600,620) = 620-600=20 minutes


def test_contract_disjoint_gap_no_overlap():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    a = Event(540, 600)  # 9*60=540, 10*60=600
    b = Event(660, 720)  # 11*60=660, 12*60=720
    assert overlaps(a, b) is False  # gap 660-600=60 minutes, no shared minute


def test_contract_free_slots_merges_unsorted():
    """Events may arrive in any order and may overlap each other."""
    events = [Event(600, 660), Event(540, 620)]  # 10*60=600, 11*60=660, 9*60=540, 620=600+20
    assert free_slots(events, 540, 720) == [(660, 720)]  # 11*60=660, 12*60=720; merged busy [540,660)


def test_contract_free_slots_min_minutes():
    """Only gaps of at least min_minutes are returned."""
    events = [Event(540, 600)]  # 9*60=540, 10*60=600
    assert free_slots(events, 540, 630, min_minutes=31) == []  # gap 630-600=30 < 31 so excluded


def test_contract_free_slots_clipped_to_day():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    events = [Event(500, 560)]  # 8*60+20=500, 9*60+20=560
    assert free_slots(events, 540, 720) == [(560, 720)]  # clipped busy [540,560); gap 720-560=160; 9*60=540, 12*60=720


def test_contract_parse_time_valid():
    """parse_time turns "HH:MM" (24-hour) into minutes."""
    assert parse_time("09:00") == 540  # 9*60+0=540


def test_contract_parse_time_invalid():
    """Anything it cannot parse raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):  # "abc" is not HH:MM
        parse_time("abc")


def test_contract_fmt_duration_example():
    """fmt_duration renders "Xh YYm" (e.g. 65 -> "1h 05m")."""
    assert fmt_duration(65) == "1h 05m"  # 65//60=1, 65%60=5 -> "1h 05m"
